answer.rationale: I intend to add write-path capacity because latency is severe, traffic is at peak, and rollback is prohibited by the security requirement. Memory_b3 supports capacity headroom during a surge, though it concerns pre-provisioning rather than emergency scaling, so I would use a guarded standard expansion while monitoring write latency, queue depth, and error rates. I am not choosing circuit breaking because shedding settlement writes risks customer-value loss, nor read-replica routing because the degradation is on writes; regional failover lacks evidence of a regional fault.
